verdict.rationale: Expensify ships AI features (SmartScan, Ask Expensify AI, auto-categorization), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product, but the evidence pack contains no documented setting or policy that keeps user data out of AI model training. Community reports describe being unable to opt out of SmartScan and receipts being shown to Mechanical Turk workers. Those reports concern human review of receipts, not a training opt-out, and there is no vendor claim for them to contradict, so the verdict is none rather than disputed.
